<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/sessions/{sessionId}/terminate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stops the session's VM but keeps its disk, so the session stays listed as terminated and can be restored later. Use only when you intend to restore the session; otherwise call DeleteSession, which works on running sessions too and frees the disk. Where the feature is enabled for the workspace, a caller holding the workspace's billing-view permission (workspace owners and billing-managing custom roles) may terminate any session of the workspace, including another member's; the usage report lists them. A Workspace API Token (`bitwat_…`) may do the same when it was created with Remote Dev Environments access and a workspace role that can manage the workspace (Manager, or a custom role with Modify workspace settings); any other workspace token, and a session token, keeps its own reach. Terminate is the only session operation this widens. The session returned for another owner's session carries only its id, name, status, owner and timestamps.
